newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Telkom to invest 4.3 trln rph in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Telkom to invest 4.3 trln rph in 1997.

text.p: Indonesia said on Tuesday it expected the state-controlled giant PT Telekomunikasi Indonesia to invest around 4.3 trillion rupiah in fiscal year 1997 starting April 1, down from 4.5 trillion rupiah in fiscal year 1996.

"The budget for Telkom's investment for the fiscal year 1997 totals 4.3 trillion rupiah," Tourism, Post and Telecommunications Minister Joop Ave said in a statement delivered during a parliamentary hearing.
He said the funds would be used primarily to finance the development of 721,000 lines mostly in Jakarta and East Java regions.
Ave said Telkom had spent 4.5 trillion rupiah in the fiscal year 1996 mostly to install 1.2 million lines particularly in Jakarta and East Java regions.
Ave did not give further details. $=2,372 rupiah
